title: Promo Card Studies
description: Five independent studies of music-video launch surfaces including teaser tiles, clip reminders, behind-the-scenes cards, and social countdown frames.
creative_direction: Independent promo cards should feel built for music-video release week: immediate focal point, strong mood hook, modular text-safe zones, and social-share clarity without readable copy or platform branding.
